Watch the latest Escape From Playtime trailer for the upcoming co-op survival horror game set within the Poppy Playtime universe, deep inside the decaying halls of the abandoned Playtime Co. The new trailer features a creepy voiceover explaining what you need to do to survive. Escape From Playtime will be available in Steam Early Access on October 21, 2026.In Excape From Playtime, players explore the facility as the Smiling Critters, the dead-eyed toy line with gaping smiles introduced in Poppy Playtime: Chapter 3. From classrooms and warehouses to testing labs and the dark corridors connecting them all, every space in the factory becomes more dangerous when seen from a Critter’s-eye view.
